name: concept-card-writer
description: Writes one-page concept cards in a consistent format, part of the Design Thinking Pack by 90n. Use this whenever the user says "run concept-card-writer", "write up these concepts", "make concept cards", "turn these ideas into one-pagers", or ideation produced winners and they need a fair, comparable write-up before prioritization. Use it even for "we picked five ideas, now what".
